rev6.release_notes: Simulate: lathe programs get their Tools list back (every tool, its type and size, correctable) and the stock size boxes (bar diameter, length, front Z, bore). The hover note over the Simulate view is gone. Help > Check for Updates now says where CAD CAM stands too.

cadcam.release_notes: Beta 2: the CAD / CAM switch stays where you put it; clicking a setup (or Ctrl-picking toolpaths) shows all their toolpath lines; six new tool models for Simulate (1/2, 3/4 and 1 in end mills, a No. 3 center drill, a 1/4 in drill, a 1.25 in face mill).
